body.label: Target
body.html: Self and up to two willing allies within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Each target reduces its next incoming Damage by 1 and resists its next 2 units of forced movement until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Each ally may move 1 unit toward you.
One protected target suppresses a non-Critical Wound Condition's numerical penalties until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Ancestor
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 3 Mana to enter Ancestor Full Manifestation (FM-2A). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
